title: The Night Train
text:
Daniel boarded the night train with only a small suitcase. The carriage was almost empty, and the window reflected his tired face. He had promised his sister that he would arrive before dawn.

When the train stopped at a small village, a woman in a red coat sat down opposite him. She said nothing, but she kept glancing at his suitcase. Daniel began to wonder whether she had been waiting for him.

questions.text: What did Daniel carry onto the train?
options: A large bag and a guitar

questions.text: What colour coat was the woman wearing?
What can be inferred about Daniel's feelings in the carriage?
options: He feels uneasy about the woman
He is excited about a holiday
He is angry with the train staff

questions.text: Why might the woman keep glancing at the suitcase?
options: She may be connected to what it contains or to Daniel's plan
She is looking for her own luggage
She is afraid of travelling by train

vocabulary.definition: a single section of a train for passengers
showed an image back, as a mirror or window does
think about something with curiosity or doubt

paragraph_translations: Daniel wsiadł do nocnego pociągu tylko z małą walizką. Wagon był prawie pusty, a okno odbijało jego zmęczoną twarz. Obiecał siostrze, że dotrze na miejsce przed świtem.

Kiedy pociąg zatrzymał się w małej wiosce, naprzeciwko niego usiadła kobieta w czerwonym płaszczu. Nic nie mówiła, ale cały czas zerkała na jego walizkę. Daniel zaczął zastanawiać się, czy na niego czekała.
